summary: Complaints centre on waterlogging, garbage fires, traffic and allegations of inflated road and culvert spending, while the main appreciation is the start of new bridge and road works.

positives.english: Work has started on a Hindon bridge linking Loni with Rajnagar Extension
positives.hindi: हिंडन पर लोनी को राजनगर एक्सटेंशन से जोड़ने वाले पुल का काम शुरू हुआ
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2026): MLA Nandkishore Gurjar launched (शुभारंभ) an approx Rs 42 crore bridge of about 182 metres over the Hindon. Start only, not completed. Exact bridge location inside the AC is not stated.

positives.english: Renovation of the Loni Teeraha to Bhopura road has started
positives.hindi: लोनी तिराहा से भोपुरा मार्ग की मरम्मत का काम शुरू हो गया है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2026): renovation of the Loni-Bhopura road launched at about Rs 6 crore, after a puja at Loni Teeraha. Loni Teeraha is to be renamed Shiv Chowk. Started, not completed.

positives.english: Cement concrete road and drain work started on Jindal Marg in DLF Colony, Loni
positives.hindi: डीएलएफ कॉलोनी के जिंदल मार्ग पर सीसी सड़क और नाले का काम शुरू हुआ
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (4 Jul 2025, event on Thursday): MLA launched (शुभारंभ) an 80 lakh CC road on Jindal Marg, DLF Colony, Loni. A drain of over Rs 1 crore on both sides was in its final stage. Dated 2025, so status may have changed.

positives.english: Banthla-Dhikauli road in Loni to be widened, tender begun, work promised before Diwali
positives.hindi: बंथला ढिकौली सड़क चौड़ी होगी, दिवाली से पहले काम शुरू होने की बात
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026): 8 km road, Rs 14.30 crore, to go from 3.75 m to 5.5 m; PWD executive engineer Ram Raja said tender process has begun and work will start before Diwali. Approval and tender only, not built yet.

positives.english: New road from Teela Mod along Pipeline Road planned under GDA Master Plan to ease jams
positives.hindi: टीला मोड़ से पाइपलाइन रोड तक नई सड़क बनेगी, जाम से राहत मिलने की उम्मीद
positives.basis: Navbharat Live (23 Apr 2026): GDA Master Plan 2031 mini pilot in Loni includes road from Teela Mod along Pipeline Road (phase 1 about 1,400 m, 30 m planned width, initial 15 m). Planned; implementation depends on committee report.

negatives.english: Waterlogging on about seven km of the Delhi-Saharanpur road in Loni after rain
negatives.hindi: बारिश होते ही लोनी में दिल्ली-सहारनपुर रोड पर सात किलोमीटर तक पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Chetna Manch (7 Sep 2026): residents report waterlogging on about 7 km of road near the Delhi-Saharanpur Road in Loni, disrupting traffic, shopkeepers and daily workers.

negatives.english: Garbage heaps in Loni are set on fire every day, causing heavy pollution
negatives.hindi: लोनी में रोज़ कूड़े के ढेर में आग लगती है, धुएं से सांस लेना मुश्किल
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (26 Mar 2025): garbage heaps in Loni set alight daily; Loni called a gas chamber, CPCB Sameer app recorded AQI 424. Dated 2025.

negatives.english: Loni roads are narrow and face regular traffic jams
negatives.hindi: लोनी में सड़कें तंग हैं, रोज़ जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Navbharat Live (23 Apr 2026): residents of Loni troubled by unplanned expansion, illegal colonies and traffic jams; Indraprastha scheme area lacks roads, causing constant jams. Teela Mod is named in the same article.

negatives.english: Allegation that road and culvert contracts in Loni were inflated in billing
negatives.hindi: सड़क और पुलिया के काम में गड़बड़ी का आरोप है, खर्च बढ़ाकर दिखाया गया
negatives.basis: Chetna Manch (7 Sep 2026): unverified allegations by local residents and unnamed sources; a culvert costing about Rs 1 lakh reportedly billed up to Rs 6 lakh. Article says no official clarification published yet.

negatives.english: No proper hospital in Loni, residents go to Delhi or Meerut for treatment
negatives.hindi: लोनी में ढंग का अस्पताल नहीं, इलाज के लिए दिल्ली या मेरठ जाना पड़ता है
negatives.basis: Maktoob (9 Feb 2022, election-year report; old): resident said there are no proper hospitals, small clinics only, and residents travel to Delhi or Meerut. Quotes are English translations in the article. Dated 2022.

notes: AC 53 Loni confirmed on Wikipedia list (None reserved, Ghaziabad district); Loni Assembly page lists Loni NP and Tronica City within the AC. Teela Mod and Pipeline Road are named in Loni-linked reports but not on the AC extent page, so AC membership for them is unconfirmed. The Hindon bridge location within the AC is not stated. Positives are thin: only started works and approvals were found, no completed Loni project. Quint Loni/Indrapuri article returned 403 and was not cited. Maktoob (2022) is the only source for the hospital item and is old. Hindi statements are my voice-style renderings of sourced facts, and the WebFetch summaries were used rather than verbatim article text, so field check the quotes. Other searches (power cuts, water supply, stray cattle, Loni CHC) found no Loni-specific 2026 reports. Field check suggestion: Amar Ujala Ghaziabad desk on Loni drains and Teela Mod garbage.
